ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: in the attached figure there is an organic structure; on the left, R¹ is connected to the carbonyl carbon C(=O), and this carbonyl carbon is further connected to nitrogen N; H is also labeled on the nitrogen, and it is connected by a single bond to O on the right; this O is further connected to another carbonyl C(=O), and the carbonyl carbon is connected to R² on the right. A negatively charged OH, namely hydroxide, is also drawn separately in the figure, and there is a reaction arrow pointing toward the N-H region. Reasoning: the problem asks to ignore the arrows, so only the covalent skeleton is retained. The main skeleton from left to right is R¹-C(=O)-N(H)-O-C(=O)-R². Replacing R¹ and R² with the SMILES wildcard * gives the organic portion *C(=O)NOC(*)=O. The separate hydroxide is written as [OH-] as an independent component, and the two components are connected with a dot, so the overall SMILES is *C(=O)NOC(*)=O.[OH-].

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Ignore the reaction arrows as instructed. Trace the main covalent skeleton left to right: R1-C(=O)-N(H)-O-C(=O)-R2. Replace R1 and R2 by wildcard atoms, giving *C(=O)NOC(*)=O for the organic structure. Then append the separate hydroxide ion visible in the image as .[OH-], yielding *C(=O)NOC(*)=O.[OH-].
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图中有一个有机结构，左侧是 R¹ 连接到羰基碳 C(=O)，该羰基碳再与氮 N 相连；氮上还标有 H，并与右侧的 O 单键相连；该 O 再连接到另一个羰基 C(=O)，羰基碳右侧连着 R²。图中还单独画有一个带负电荷的 OH，即氢氧根，并有反应箭头指向 N-H 区域。推理：题目要求忽略箭头，因此只保留共价骨架。主骨架从左到右是 R¹-C(=O)-N(H)-O-C(=O)-R²。用 SMILES 的通配符 * 替代 R¹ 和 R²，得到有机部分 *C(=O)NOC(*)=O。单独的氢氧根作为独立组分写作 [OH-]，用点号连接两个组分，因此整体 SMILES 为 *C(=O)NOC(*)=O.[OH-]。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the drawn molecule after ignoring the curved arrows: a left generic substituent R1 attached to a carbonyl carbon, then amide N bearing H, then O, then a second carbonyl carbon attached to generic R2; also read a separate hydroxide ion, OH with a negative charge.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the desired output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions for generic R groups as wildcard atoms '*', carbonyl as C(=O), single-bond connectivity along the chain, implicit H on neutral amide N when written as N, and disconnected species separated by '.'. Encode hydroxide as [OH-].
